svg.title: Agent work cycle: simple-coding-agent v0.3.2
svg.desc: Startup and polling, claimed, setup, model_running, pushing, publishing, and finalization. Failed pushes and partial work go to the outcome comment. The agent can return to the issue queue after cleanup. Every node links to its source code. Skills used during model_running: implement, tdd, code-review, codebase-design, and conditional handoff.
svg.text: simple-coding-agent v0.3.2 · lifecycle phases and decision paths
01 Startup and queue · outside attempt phases

g.title: handoff · conditional skill — only when instructed: resource limit or operator request

svg.text: Skills: implementation · tests · review · module design. Handoff: preserve work + commit note when instructed (limit / operator).
07 Outcome and cleanup · no separate lifecycle phase
